channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Scandal-hit agriculture minister Yana announces resignation
item.description: His sudden exit deals a blow to Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's administration, with key bills involving his ministry being debated in parliament.

item.title: Russia arrests Japanese journalist on spying charges
item.description: The Hokkaido Shimbun journalist is accused of collecting information on Moscow's defence capabilities for Tokyo.

item.title: Hakkaku’s complex legacy looms over sumo’s next chapter
item.description: The Japan Sumo Association chairman will step down in 2028, setting the stage for a potentially fierce succession battle.

item.title: U.K. and Indian economies set to overtake Japan, IMF says
item.description: A weak yen and rising costs for Japanese households have India and the U.K. on course to overtake Japan in GDP next year.

item.title: Japan eyes penalties for unauthorized land deals near SDF bases
item.description: Land transactions in areas around Self-Defense Forces bases and Japan Coast Guard facilities would require prior approval from the central government.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
